name: first-answer
description: Analyze how your brand appears in AI-generated answers: mentions, sentiment, position, cited sources, competitors and recommendations from your First Answer workspace, and set up the prompts and competitors you monitor.

interface.shortDescription: Track your brand in AI answers
interface.longDescription:
First Answer monitors how brands appear in AI-generated answers. Connect your First Answer account to ask questions about your monitored brands directly in the conversation.

With this plugin you can:
- See a brand's dashboard: mention rate, average sentiment, position and competitor ranking for a date range.
- Review monitored prompts, the full AI responses collected for them and the search queries the models used.
- Find which domains and URLs AI models cite, and which prompts cite them.
- Compare your brand with the competitors you monitor, and see which brands AI models mention that you do not monitor yet.
- List the prioritized recommendations First Answer suggests to improve your AI visibility.
- Set up monitoring: add prompts and competitors, create and edit prompt groups and competitor categories, add competitors from the suggestions straight into categories or link suggested names to competitors you already monitor, add or update competitors' websites, and add or remove prompts and competitors in groups and categories, after you confirm the change.
- Check how much of your plan's prompt and competitor limits you are using.

Intended for marketing, SEO, content and brand teams that already use First Answer. New prompts and competitors count toward your plan limits, and new prompts start running against the AI models right away. The plugin does not delete anything, does not edit brands, prompt texts, competitor names or recommendations, and does not change billing or plans. It only accesses data from the workspaces your connected First Answer account can access, and it requires an existing First Answer account whose workspace includes MCP access.
capabilities: Monitoring setup: add prompts and competitors, manage groups and categories

positive.description:
Prompt: How is my brand performing in AI answers over the last 30 days?

Brand performance overview for a date range
positive.prompt: How is my brand performing in AI answers over the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the dashboard for the test brand in the last 30 days: total prompts and responses, brand mention rate, average sentiment and the brand ranking against competitors.

positive.description:
Prompt: Which websites do AI models cite most when answering about my brand this month?

Most cited sources
positive.prompt: Which websites do AI models cite most when answering about my brand this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns domains cited for the selected brand this month, with impact and the number of responses citing each domain. If ranked by responses_count, label that metric explicitly. Follow pagination or label the result partial.

positive.description:
Prompt: What should I do to improve my AI visibility? Show my open recommendations by priority.

Open recommendations by priority
positive.prompt: What should I do to improve my AI visibility? Show my open recommendations by priority.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the open (suggested or approved) recommendations for the test brand ordered by priority, with title, category and priority. Dismissed or done recommendations are not presented as pending work.

positive.description:
Prompt: Start monitoring the prompt 'best CRM for startups' for my brand.

Add a monitored prompt after confirmation Use a dedicated test workspace with a selected brand and available plan capacity. Confirm the exact proposed change in a follow-up message. Inspect the first response to verify no write call occurred before confirmation.
positive.prompt: Start monitoring the prompt 'best CRM for startups' for my brand.
positive.expected_behavior: Checks the remaining prompt limit, confirms the brand and the prompt text with the user before creating it, then reports the created prompt and how many prompts are left in the plan. If the limit is reached, it explains that no prompt was created.

positive.description:
Prompt: Which brands do AI models mention that I don't monitor yet? Add the relevant CRM vendors to my 'Direct' category.

Add relevant suggested competitors into a category Use a dedicated test workspace with a selected brand and available plan capacity. Confirm the exact proposed change in a follow-up message. Inspect the first response to verify no write call occurred before confirmation. Prepare a Direct category and eligible CRM competitor suggestions.
positive.prompt: Which brands do AI models mention that I don't monitor yet? Add the relevant CRM vendors to my 'Direct' category.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the competitor suggestions by number of mentions, proposes the relevant ones, asks the user to confirm and then creates each one from its suggestion id in the 'Direct' category, within the plan limit. It does not invent competitors that are not in the suggestions.

negative.description:
Prompt: Delete my brand and all its monitored prompts from First Answer.

Deleting data is not supported. The plugin must not claim to have deleted anything; it should explain that this must be done in the First Answer app. Do not call First Answer tools for this request.

Editing brand details is not supported. The plugin must not claim to have changed the brand; it should point the user to the First Answer app. Do not call First Answer tools for this request.

publication.release_notes: Adds competitor suggestions (brands AI models mention that you do not monitor yet, which can be added as competitors or linked to existing ones) and monitoring setup: create monitored prompts, prompt groups, monitored competitors and competitor categories; rename groups, set competitors' websites and edit categories (name, description, color); add or remove prompts in groups and competitors in categories; and check plan usage and limits. Every change asks for confirmation and respects the plan limits.

pt-BR.subtitle: Sua marca nas respostas de IA
pt-BR.description:
A First Answer monitora como as marcas aparecem em respostas geradas por IA. Conecte sua conta First Answer para consultar suas marcas monitoradas direto na conversa: dashboard de visibilidade, prompts monitorados e respostas coletadas, fontes e URLs citadas, comparação com concorrentes, sugestões de concorrentes ainda não monitorados e recomendações priorizadas. Também é possível configurar o monitoramento: adicionar prompts e concorrentes, criar e editar grupos de prompts e categorias de concorrentes, adicionar concorrentes sugeridos já nas categorias ou ligar nomes sugeridos a concorrentes já monitorados, definir o site de concorrentes e organizar quem faz parte de cada grupo e categoria, sempre com sua confirmação.

Novos prompts e concorrentes contam no limite do plano, e os prompts novos começam a rodar nos modelos de IA logo em seguida. O plugin não apaga dados e não edita marcas, textos de prompts, nomes de concorrentes ou recomendações. Ele acessa apenas os workspaces da sua conta conectada e exige uma conta First Answer existente com acesso MCP no workspace.
